GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. You hear: "Das ist mein Vater. Er heißt Juma. Er ist groß." What is the gist? (1 mark)
   A. Someone talks about the weather
   B. A child describes a sister
   C. Someone orders food
   D. A child describes his or her father

2. What does "die Oma" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. grandmother
   B. son
   C. grandfather
   D. parents

3. In the word "Schlafzimmer", which part means "sleep"? (1 mark)
   A. Zimmer
   B. zim
   C. Schlaf
   D. mer

4. If today is Mittwoch, what was yesterday (gestern)? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Freitag
   C. Montag
   D. Dienstag

5. What does "der Luftballon" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. party
   B. present
   C. birthday
   D. balloon

6. What does "der Hals" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. toe
   B. eye
   C. neck
   D. leg

7. How is "st" pronounced at the start of "Stuhl"? (1 mark)
   A. like sht
   B. like sk
   C. like sd
   D. like st in stone

8. How is "w" pronounced in "Wasser"? (1 mark)
   A. like f
   B. like English w
   C. like b
   D. like v

9. Which sound needs rounded lips? (1 mark)
   A. ü
   B. i
   C. a
   D. e

10. What does "die Geschwister" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. aunt
   B. brother
   C. daughter
   D. brothers and sisters

11. What does "das Schlafzimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sofa
   B. clock
   C. wall
   D. bedroom

12. What does "das Wochenende" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. week
   B. day
   C. Sunday
   D. weekend

13. What is the plural of "das Buch"? (1 mark)
   A. die Buchen
   B. die Buche
   C. die Bücher
   D. die Buchs

14. Which little word goes with the noun "Geschenk"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. das
   D. der

15. Which German word is the number 15? (1 mark)
   A. null
   B. neunzehn
   C. fünfzehn
   D. eins

16. Which food group does "die Mango" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Obst
   D. das Gemüse

17. What does "lecker" mean? (1 mark)
   A. big
   B. healthy
   C. cold
   D. tasty

18. What does "Ich mag keine Cola" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I do not like cola
   B. I like cola
   C. I am buying cola
   D. I drink cola every day

19. Which little word goes with the noun "Bein"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

20. Which little word goes with the noun "Auge"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. der
   D. den

21. Which body part do we link with "hören"? (1 mark)
   A. die Hand
   B. das Auge
   C. die Nase
   D. das Ohr

22. What does "die Wolke" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. wind
   B. weather
   C. cloud
   D. thunderstorm

23. What does "der Wind" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thunderstorm
   B. rainbow
   C. wind
   D. rain

24. Which verb form completes "Der Hund ___ im Garten"? (schlafen) (1 mark)
   A. schlaft
   B. schläft
   C. schlafen
   D. schlafe

25. What does "über" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. above
   C. next to
   D. behind

26. Which German word or phrase means "father"? (1 mark)
   A. die Mutter
   B. die Tante
   C. der Vater
   D. die Familie

27. Which special letter is in "fleißig"? (1 mark)
   A. ß
   B. ü
   C. ö
   D. ä

28. Which form completes "Ihr ___ ein Haus"? (1 mark)
   A. hast
   B. habe
   C. hat
   D. habt

29. Which German word or phrase means "house"? (1 mark)
   A. das Haus
   B. der Kühlschrank
   C. das Schlafzimmer
   D. die Toilette

30. What does "essen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to smell
   B. to help
   C. to play
   D. to eat

31. Which of these is NOT a noun? (1 mark)
   A. Montag
   B. spiele
   C. Schule
   D. Fußball

32. Which German word means "to drink"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. hören
   B. lesen
   C. trinken
   D. schlafen

33. What does "Oktober" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. October
   B. December
   C. July
   D. June

34. What is the plural of "das Geschenk"? (1 mark)
   A. die Geschenken
   B. die Geschenks
   C. die Geschenke
   D. die Geschenker

35. Which food group does "die Wassermelone" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Obst
   B. das Gemüse
   C. das Fleisch
   D. die Getränke

36. Which little word goes with the noun "Banane"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. den
   D. die

37. Which German word or phrase means "carrot"? (1 mark)
   A. die Karotte
   B. der Kohl
   C. das Brot
   D. die Mango

38. Which word is written with a capital letter? (1 mark)
   A. windig
   B. kalt
   C. warm
   D. Regen

39. Which verb means "blows" in "Der Wind ___"? (1 mark)
   A. scheint
   B. regnet
   C. schneit
   D. weht

40. Which little word goes with the noun "Nebel"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. die
   D. den

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Read: "Im Wohnzimmer ist ein Sofa. In der Küche ist ein Kühlschrank." Say where each item is in English. (3 marks)

42. Give three tips for reading a tongue twister well. (3 marks)

43. Write these numbers in German: 2, 6, 10. (3 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: present, aunt, mango. (3 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fork, wall. (2 marks)

46. Write the German words with der, die or das for: rice, breakfast, table, fridge, kitchen. (5 marks)

47. Explain when to use "mein" and when to use "meine". Give one example of each. (3 marks)

48. Write the German words with der or die for: father, mother, brother, sister. (4 marks)

49. Write the German birthday wish "All the best for your birthday". (2 marks)

50. Write the German words with der, die or das for: water, rice, breakfast. (3 marks)

51. Describe the structure of an Elfchen, line by line. (3 marks)

52. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tummy, apple, cheese. (3 marks)

53. Write two sentences about healthy food and one about unhealthy food in German. (3 marks)

54. Write the German words with their articles for: rice, milk, egg, banana. (4 marks)

55. Write the German words with der, die or das for: spoon, supper. (2 marks)

56. Write the German words with der, die or das for: finger, brothers and sisters, wind. (3 marks)

57. Explain why breaking a long word into parts helps you read it. Use Donnerstag as an example. (2 marks)

58. Say why the word "Schlafzimmer" is a das word. (2 marks)

59. Write two sentences in German: one about a food you like to eat and one about a drink you like to drink. (3 marks)

60. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knife, balloon. (2 marks)

61. You hear "Auf dem Mount Kenya ist es kalt. Dort schneit es manchmal." What is the gist? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — A child describes his or her father
   The words Vater, heißt and groß tell us it is about a father.

2. A — grandmother
   die Oma means grandmother.

3. C — Schlaf
   Schlaf means sleep and Zimmer means room.

4. D — Dienstag
   The day before Mittwoch is Dienstag.

5. D — balloon
   der Luftballon means balloon.

6. C — neck
   der Hals means neck.

7. A — like sht
   At the start of a word st sounds like sht.

8. D — like v
   German w sounds like v, so Wasser is VAS-ser.

9. A — ü
   To say ü, say ee with round lips as if whistling.

10. D — brothers and sisters
   die Geschwister means brothers and sisters.

11. D — bedroom
   das Schlafzimmer means bedroom.

12. D — weekend
   das Wochenende means weekend.

13. C — die Bücher
   The plural of das Buch is die Bücher.

14. C — das
   It is das Geschenk, so the little word is das.

15. C — fünfzehn
   15 in German is fünfzehn.

16. C — das Obst
   die Mango belongs to das Obst.

17. D — tasty
   lecker means tasty.

18. A — I do not like cola
   keine shows that the person does not like cola.

19. A — das
   It is das Bein, so the little word is das.

20. A — das
   It is das Auge, so the little word is das.

21. D — das Ohr
   We hear with the ears.

22. C — cloud
   die Wolke means cloud.

23. C — wind
   der Wind means wind.

24. B — schläft
   schlafen changes to schläft for er, sie and es.

25. B — above
   über means above.

26. C — der Vater
   father in German is der Vater.

27. A — ß
   fleißig has ß.

28. D — habt
   ihr goes with habt.

29. A — das Haus
   house in German is das Haus.

30. D — to eat
   essen means to eat.

31. B — spiele
   spiele is a verb. Nouns begin with capital letters.

32. C — trinken
   to drink in German is trinken.

33. A — October
   Oktober means October.

34. C — die Geschenke
   The plural of das Geschenk is die Geschenke.

35. A — das Obst
   die Wassermelone belongs to das Obst.

36. D — die
   It is die Banane, so the little word is die.

37. A — die Karotte
   carrot in German is die Karotte.

38. D — Regen
   Regen is a noun. Adjectives are small.

39. D — weht
   Der Wind weht means the wind blows.

40. B — der
   It is der Nebel, so the little word is der.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: The sofa is in the living room. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct place and 1 mark for the items.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read slowly at first; add a few words at a time; speed up only when it is clear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible tip.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: zwei, sechs, zehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Geschenk, die Tante, die Mango.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Gabel, die Wand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, das Frühstück, der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use mein with der and das nouns (mein Vater) and meine with die nouns and plurals (meine Mutter).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule and 1 mark for correct examples.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Vater, die Mutter, der Bruder, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each noun with the correct article.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the words and 1 mark for correct spelling and punctuation.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Wasser, der Reis, das Frühstück.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Line 1: one word; line 2: two words; line 3: three words; line 4: four words; line 5: one word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for lines 1 and 2, 1 mark for lines 3 and 4, 1 mark for line 5 and the total of 11.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Obst ist gesund. Wasser ist gesund. Limonade ist ungesund.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, die Milch, das Ei, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Löffel, das Abendessen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Finger, die Geschwister, der Wind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Small parts are easier to say, for example Don-ners-tag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for the example.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Its last part, Zimmer, is a das word, and a joined word takes the article of the last part.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for last part, 1 mark for Zimmer being das.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich esse gern Mais. Ich trinke gern Tee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Messer, der Luftballon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is cold on Mount Kenya and sometimes it snows there.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for cold, 1 mark for snow.
